name: Sweet Leaves
source:
Red Ellsworth relocates across the country to a remote Minnesota town, leaning on the Graingers and their circle as he rebuilds his life. 

When he finally starts to settle, a strange and remarkable event changes his direction entirely.

[From [url=https://sweetleaves.itch.io/sweet-leaves]Itch.io[/url]]
